{{Top|leg}}
A '''Landmark Holiday''' was a celebration that could be declared by the [[Brentaal League of Guilds]], as they did as a result of record trading in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The week-long Landmark Holiday celebration included parades and parties held by [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal's]] noble houses and an encore performance of the [[The Kallea Cycle|Kallea Cycle]] by the [[Brentaal Hall Conservatory]]. Though the Brentaal commodities exchanges were closed, numerous expediting houses remained open to ensure the continued flow of market goods.
